Second native pre-release of ParanO(1)d.

This release is intended for controlled multi-node, wallet and cross-platform
testing before mainnet.

The self-contained node, CLI, external miner and independently installable GUI
wallet are built for Linux x86-64, Linux ARM64, Windows x86-64, macOS Apple
Silicon and macOS Intel.

Pre-genesis software. This version is not the final mainnet launch.
